description: Get the assignment or quiz scores that contributed to one outcome_id's results for one or more students in a course, optionally restricted to assignment alignments only or including unpublished assignments. Use get_outcome_results instead for the final per-alignment outcome score rather than the scores that fed it, or get_outcome_alignments to list all alignments in the course (not scoped to this outcome) without their scores.

only_assignment_alignments.description: Limit results to assignment alignments only.

show_unpublished_assignments.description: Include unpublished assignments in the contributing score results.

user_ids.description: Optional Canvas user IDs (pass large IDs as strings) or SIS user IDs prefixed with "sis_user_id:".

name: get_outcome_contributing_scores
title: Get Outcome Contributing Scores
